description: Check the seller's current plan, remaining item slots, and whether an upgrade is needed. Use this before creating listings to ensure capacity, and after sending a payment link to confirm the upgrade completed. summary is a short human-readable status line. It may say upgrade where a renewal applies, so do not re-derive a different one from the raw numbers, but before quoting a price or naming a plan, check tier and the expiry fields yourself — an expired paid plan and a plan that never existed need different things said to the seller.
name: check_tier_status
title: Check Tier Status
